intro.text: A Darkside power on Taldain, whose users are known as the Starcarved.

description.text: Few can gain the power, and those who do must first be shown it by another Starcarved.
Starmarks come in several colours. Some uses let the Starcarved form razor-sharp blades or shields that can stop bullets.
On Dayside, starmarks neither work nor can be seen.
